prompt: Our marketing team needs a structured snapshot of the current top trending topics on Douyin (抖音) for campaign planning this week. Specifically, we want the top 15 trending items captured in a machine-readable file called `trending_report.json`. Each entry in the file should be a complete record with all available metadata — including any cover image URLs where they exist (some items may not have one, which should be represented appropriately), hotness scores as actual numbers, clickable links, content category, labels, and ranking position. Please use the tooling available in the workspace to fetch and produce this file.
